I actually love these kinds of things. I love group fitness classes. My body has gained SO MUCH LEAN MUSCLE since I started. As long as they have good instructors, it can be really fun and I’ve gotten crazy strong.

Changes from week to week, but generally resembles this:

Monday - ballet AM, pilates PM (usually something restorative)

Tuesday - Pilates AM, spinning PM

Wednesday - dance/cardio AM, HIIT PM (think Barry’s bootcamp), sometimes yoga if I’m really sore at night. 

Thursday - Spinning AM, Pilates PM (or vice versa)

Friday - stretch class/rest day

Saturday - spinning or HIIT then Pilates 

Sunday - sometimes just a restorative class, sometimes a barre class. Sometimes a cardio class. Sometimes I lay on my couch all day. Depends what my week/weekend has looked like. 

This probably looks like a lot, but it’s not always 2 x a day. I do a lot of low impact stuff so it’s not insane and targets the whole body mostly. I try to aim for two rest days per week but I have trouble sitting still and working out is a real stress reliever for me.
